note: Set A is better because it contains fewer factual errors regarding dimension bindings. While Set A incorrectly labels South Bathroom as D5 (D5 is North Kitchen) and misassigns some North Kitchen dimensions to West Bathroom, Set B makes more severe errors such as assigning the 17' width (which belongs to East/West Kitchen) to North Kitchen and North Bathroom, and misinterpreting finish codes (P3) as heights.
